# Public Snapshot (GitHub Pages)

This folder hosts a **read-only snapshot** of the quant trading dashboard,
auto-generated every ~30 minutes by `agents/snapshot_generator.py`.

Live URL: https://zzwjlwwdtg.github.io/quant-trading-framework/

**Do not edit files here manually** — they are overwritten by the generator.

For source code / architecture, see [../README.md](../README.md) and
the `agents/` folder.
